subject: general
question: The Sunni and Shia are the two major sects in which religion or belief?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Islam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Islam**

 
 
• Islam, the world's second-largest religion, follows the teachings of the Quran and the prophet Muhammad.
 
• Muslims believe in one God, Allah, and strive to live a life of submission to His will.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ​ Sikhism**

 
 
• Sikhism, originating in Punjab, India, emphasizes the equality of all humans and the importance of living a just and virtuous life.
 
• Sikhs believe in one God, known as Waheguru, and follow the teachings of the ten Gurus.
 
 
 
• **Judaism**
 
 
• Judaism, one of the oldest religions, is based on the Torah and the teachings of the prophets.
 
• Jews believe in one God, Yahweh, and follow a set of laws and traditions known as Halakha. 
 
 
 
• **Parsi**
 
 
• Parsi, also known as Zoroastrianism, is an ancient Iranian religion that emphasizes the importance of good thoughts, good words, and good deeds. Parsis believe in a single God, Ahura Mazda, and the eternal struggle between good and evil.
